KNOW #9 📚 Market Sessions (Ist)
Forex 24 ghante chalta hai, par har ghanta same nahi.
• Asia session subah, lagbhag 5:30 AM se. Move zyaadatar chhota.
• London lagbhag 1:30 PM se. Volume aur move dono badhte hain.
• New York lagbhag 6:30 PM se. London + NY overlap sabse tez time hai.
Tip: apne pair ka active session pehchano aur usi me trade karo.
Aur seekhna hai to follow karo. Trade setups ke liye Telegram join karo — link bio me 🕷️
